editorialIntro.heading: How Is the Dining on Oceania Cruises?
paragraphs: Oceania Cruises is known for a culinary program that combines traditional fine dining, international cuisine, specialty restaurants and more relaxed options. Guests can choose from elegant sit-down restaurants, casual cafés, poolside dining, afternoon tea and complimentary in-room dining.

A major advantage is that most restaurants, including the principal specialty dining venues, are included in the cruise fare. Unlike some cruise lines that charge an additional cover fee for every specialty restaurant visit, Oceania generally includes its regular specialty dining experiences without an extra restaurant surcharge. Reservations are still required at selected venues, and availability depends on the ship and sailing.

The experience is not limited to dinner. Guests can enjoy made-to-order breakfast, leisurely lunches, changing dinner menus, international selections and dishes inspired by destinations along the itinerary.

restaurantOverview.title: Oceania Cruises Restaurants: Complete Overview
intro: Oceania offers several distinct dining styles, from formal multi-course evening meals to relaxed outdoor poolside lunches.
The following 11 dining venues represent the heart of Oceania's acclaimed culinary portfolio across its fleet.

venues.title: The Grand Dining Room
paragraphs: The Grand Dining Room is Oceania's principal restaurant and one of the central parts of its onboard dining experience. Its elegant surroundings, attentive service and broad menu make it a popular choice for breakfast, lunch and dinner.

The menu combines Continental favorites, international dishes, selections associated with Executive Culinary Director Jacques Pépin and lighter options. Menus change daily, so the dishes available on one evening will not repeat throughout your voyage.
Dining Details: Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Open-seating dining style with no reservations required. Country-club casual atmosphere. Fully included in cruise fare across all ships.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: Classic Continental dishes and changing daily chef specialties
Fresh seafood, poultry, and premium meat entrées
Jacques Pépin-inspired signature appetizers and sauces
Vegetarian, plant-forward, and Aquamar Vitality Cuisine selections
Decadent dessert selections and artisan cheese boards

lists.title: Who Should Choose It?
items: Guests who enjoy a leisurely, formal dining room ambiance without the constraint of advance reservations.
Travelers who value daily variety and dishes inspired by the ports visited on each itinerary.

venues.title: Polo Grill
paragraphs: Polo Grill is Oceania's traditional steakhouse, with a menu centered on classic American steakhouse dishes and seafood. The restaurant offers a more formal evening atmosphere, with rich wood paneling, crisp white linens, and leather seating.

Dining Details: Open exclusively for dinner. Reservations required. Traditional steakhouse dining style. Generally included in the cruise fare on Marina, Riviera, Vista, Allura, Nautica, and Insignia.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: USDA Prime 28-day dry-aged beef cuts and tender filet mignon
Whole steamed or grilled Maine lobster preparations
Pan-seared jumbo sea scallops and grilled Alaskan halibut
Tableside classic Caesar salad and iceberg wedge with blue cheese
Traditional steakhouse sides: creamed spinach, truffle fries, and roasted asparagus
Classic American desserts including New York cheesecake and key lime pie

venues.title: Toscana
paragraphs: Toscana celebrates Italian cooking, with recipes inspired by regional traditions and family kitchens across Tuscany, Piedmont, and the Amalfi Coast. The restaurant is celebrated for its custom Versace china and warm, attentive tableside service.
Dining Details: Open for dinner. Reservations required. Authentic regional Italian dining style. Included in the cruise fare on Marina, Riviera, Vista, Allura, Nautica, and Insignia.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: Artisanal antipasti cart with aged prosciutto, bresaola, and marinated olives
Handmade fresh pasta: tortelloni, tagliolini with lobster, and handmade gnocchi
Slow-simmered regional risottos with saffron, wild mushrooms, or seafood
Traditional meat entrées: Osso buco alla Milanese and Florentine beef steaks
Pan-roasted Mediterranean branzino and fresh herb-crusted sea bass
Classic Italian desserts: authentic tiramisu, cannoli, and artisanal panna cotta

venues.title: Jacques
paragraphs: Jacques is Oceania's signature French restaurant named after the celebrated chef Jacques Pépin, Oceania's founding Executive Culinary Director. Its atmosphere takes inspiration from a classic Parisian bistro, featuring heirloom artworks and intimate banquette seating.
Dining Details: Open for dinner. Reservations required. Refined French bistro dining style. Included in the cruise fare on selected ships: Marina, Riviera, Vista, and Allura.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: Classic French appetizers: escargots de Bourgogne and duck foie gras terrine
Showpiece rotisserie meats: herb-roasted chicken and prime rib of beef
Traditional regional classics: slow-braised coq au vin and bouillabaisse
Dover sole meunière filleted tableside with lemon brown butter
Artisanal French cheese cart curated with regional AOC selections
Classic French pastries: warm Grand Marnier soufflé and tarte tatin

venues.title: Red Ginger
paragraphs: Red Ginger offers contemporary interpretations of Asian cuisine, featuring ebony woods, red lacquer accents, and hand-blown glass light fixtures. Its menu draws bold inspiration from Thai, Malaysian, Japanese, and Vietnamese culinary traditions.
Dining Details: Open for dinner. Reservations required. Contemporary pan-Asian dining style. Included in the cruise fare on Marina, Riviera, Vista, Allura, and Sirena.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: Crispy duck salad with watermelon, mint, toasted coconut, and sweet chili
Miso-glazed sea bass wrapped in hoba leaf (a signature guest favorite)
Aromatic Malaysian beef rendang and Thai red curry with tiger prawns
Sushi, sashimi, and tempura selections prepared fresh to order
Vegetable-based creations: wok-tossed morning glory and spicy eggplant
Exotic desserts: ginger caramel cake and Japanese matcha green tea ice cream

venues.title: Tuscan Steak
paragraphs: Tuscan Steak combines elements of a traditional American steakhouse with the rustic, olive-oil-infused flavors of Tuscany. This venue is unique within the fleet and serves as the signature specialty venue on Oceania Sirena.
Dining Details: Open for dinner. Reservations required. Italian-influenced steakhouse dining. Included in the cruise fare exclusively on Oceania Sirena.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: Florentine-style grilled T-bone steaks and prime rib-eye cuts
Lobster fra diavolo over freshly made linguine
Veal chop alla Milanese and pan-seared pork belly with balsamic glaze
House-made pasta favorites paired with rich truffle cream sauces
Crisp polenta fries, roasted garlic mash, and sautéed wild greens

venues.title: Terrace Café
paragraphs: Terrace Café is Oceania's relaxed buffet-style restaurant, offering indoor air-conditioned seating and shaded alfresco teak deck tables. It provides unmatched dining flexibility without needing any reservations.
Dining Details: Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Open-seating, casual buffet and live-action cooking stations. Included on all Oceania ships.

lists.title: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner Highlights
items: Breakfast: Eggs prepared to order, fresh fruit, pastries, and smoked salmon
Lunch: Rotisserie carving stations, freshly tossed salads, pasta, and pizza
Dinner: Grilled lobster tails, lamb cutlets, steaks, and fresh sushi/sashimi
Alfresco sunset dining with ocean breezes and panoramic wake views

venues.title: Waves Grill
paragraphs: Located just steps from the swimming pool, Waves Grill offers casual alfresco dining in a relaxed daytime setting. It is the perfect choice for a casual bite between shore excursions or sunbathing.
Dining Details: Open for lunch and mid-afternoon dining. Open-seating, poolside casual. Included on all Oceania ships.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: Gourmet burgers: The Kobe Burger with caramelized onions and blue cheese
Grilled seafood: mahi-mahi sandwich, garlic prawns, and calamari
Crispy french fries, sweet potato fries, and fresh garden salads
Handmade milkshakes, smoothies, and artisan gelato by the scoop

venues.title: Aquamar Kitchen
paragraphs: Aquamar Kitchen brings wellness-focused cuisine to life without sacrificing indulgence. Introduced on Vista and Allura, and added to Marina during refurbishment, it highlights fresh, clean ingredients and nourishing flavor combinations.
Dining Details: Open for breakfast and lunch. Casual open-seating, no reservations required. Fully included on Vista, Allura, and Marina.

lists.title: What You May Find on the Menu
items: Breakfast: Cold-pressed juices, organic smoothies, and chia seed pudding bowls
Artisanal avocado toast with poached eggs and microgreens
Lunch: Yellowfin tuna poke bowls with sesame and brown rice
Lebanese salad bowls, roasted veggie falafel wraps, and grilled salmon tacos
Refreshing nonalcoholic mocktails infused with fresh botanical herbs

venues.title: Baristas and Bakery
paragraphs: Baristas is Oceania's chic Italian coffee bar, serving expertly pulled Illy espresso drinks crafted by professional baristas alongside freshly baked morning pastries and afternoon biscotti.
Dining Details: Open throughout the morning and afternoon. Complimentary espresso, cappuccino, and pastries included on all ships.

lists.title: What to Expect at Baristas
items: Complimentary double espresso, cappuccino, macchiato, and lattes
Freshly baked croissants, fruit Danish, and warm cookies
Italian biscotti and miniature afternoon tea sandwiches
Relaxed lounge seating overlooking panoramic sea views

venues.title: Afternoon Tea
paragraphs: Afternoon Tea is a cherished Oceania tradition served daily at four o'clock in the Horizon Lounge. Guests are accompanied by the gentle melodies of a classical string quartet as white-gloved waiters present four tiers of culinary delights.
Dining Details: Daily 4:00 PM afternoon service. Open-seating, no reservations required. Fully included on all Oceania ships.

lists.title: Traditional Afternoon Tea Service
items: Traditional finger sandwiches: cucumber & dill, smoked salmon, and egg salad
Warm freshly baked British scones served with clotted cream and strawberry jam
Miniature French éclairs, fruit tartlets, macarons, and petit fours
Curated artisanal loose-leaf teas served in fine bone china

reservationsGuide.title: How Do Oceania Cruises Dining Reservations Work?
reservationsGuide.subtitle: A PRACTICAL 4-PHASE GUIDE TO PLANNING YOUR SPECIALTY SEATINGS

steps.title: Before Booking: Evaluate Ship Restaurant Lineups
steps.description: Compare vessel layouts to ensure your preferred specialty venues (such as Jacques, Red Ginger, or Aquamar Kitchen) are featured on the ship you plan to sail.

steps.title: After Booking: Check Stateroom Booking Windows
steps.description: Specialty dining reservation windows open online prior to departure based on accommodation tier (Suites receive the earliest priority window, followed by Concierge and Veranda).

steps.title: Pre-Departure: Reserve Through Oceania's Portal
steps.description: Log into your Oceania account to secure one reservation in each included specialty restaurant for your sailing, selecting preferred dining times and party sizes.

steps.title: Once Onboard: Request Additional Visits & Table Preferences
steps.description: Visit the dining reservations desk on embarkation day to request second visits or adjust seating times. Maitre d's accommodate walk-ins and additional bookings subject to nightly capacity.

cards.title: Open-Seating Dining Benefits
items: Dine whenever you wish during open restaurant hours without rigid fixed early or late seating assignments.
Perfect flexibility around long port days, sunset sailaways, and evening shore excursions.
Freedom to choose a table for two, join a lively table of new friends, or dine with traveling companions.
The Grand Dining Room and Terrace Café never require advance bookings—simply arrive when ready.
Enjoy diverse dining styles nightly, from a quick poolside grill lunch to a relaxed 4-course banquet.

cards.title: Complimentary 24-Hour Room Service & Suite Perks
items: Complimentary around-the-clock in-room dining available to every stateroom and suite category.
Order hot breakfasts, crisp salads, Angus burgers, and desserts directly to your private veranda.
Concierge Level and Suites enjoy an expanded room-service menu ordered directly from The Grand Dining Room.
Penthouse and upper suite guests receive full course-by-course in-suite dining served by a dedicated butler.
Ideal for early excursion departures, quiet romantic evenings, or dining under the stars on your veranda.

items.label: Wellness Venue
items.description: Dedicated clean-eating venue serving smoothie bowls, avocado toast, poke, and fresh juices on Vista, Allura, and Marina.

items.label: Plant-Forward

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Oceania Cruises Dining
faqs.subtitle: EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT RESTAURANTS, MENUS & RESERVATIONS

questions.question: Is dining included on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Yes. Most regular dining venues, including the main dining room, casual restaurants and regular specialty restaurants, are included in the cruise fare. Certain premium culinary experiences and optional purchases may cost extra.

questions.question: Are specialty restaurants free on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Oceania generally includes its regular specialty restaurant dining without a separate cover charge. Reservations are required at selected venues, and availability depends on the ship and sailing.

questions.question: How many restaurants are on an Oceania cruise ship?
questions.answer: The number varies by ship. Newer and larger ships (Allura, Vista, Marina, Riviera) generally offer 7 to 9 dining venues, while smaller R-Class ships (Nautica, Insignia, Sirena) feature a more compact lineup of 4 to 5 dining options.

questions.question: Which Oceania ship has the best restaurants?
questions.answer: Allura and Vista offer Oceania's most extensive culinary lineups, featuring Aquamar Kitchen, Jacques, Red Ginger, Polo Grill, Toscana, and Ember alongside The Grand Dining Room. Marina and Riviera also offer exceptional dining variety.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises have a steakhouse?
questions.answer: Yes. Polo Grill is Oceania's traditional steakhouse on several ships, serving 28-day dry-aged USDA Prime beef and Maine lobster. Oceania Sirena features Tuscan Steak, which combines steakhouse cuts with Italian regional specialties.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises have an Italian restaurant?
questions.answer: Yes. Toscana is Oceania's signature Italian specialty restaurant on selected ships. It features regional Italian dishes, handmade pasta, risotto, fresh Mediterranean seafood, and traditional desserts served on custom Versace china.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises have a French restaurant?
questions.answer: Yes. Jacques is a celebrated French-inspired specialty restaurant available on selected ships, including Marina, Riviera, Vista, and Allura, featuring recipes curated by founding Executive Culinary Director Jacques Pépin.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises have an Asian restaurant?
questions.answer: Yes. Red Ginger offers contemporary Asian cuisine on Marina, Riviera, Vista, Allura, and Sirena, featuring bold flavors inspired by Thai, Malaysian, Japanese, and Vietnamese culinary traditions.

questions.question: Are Oceania Cruises dining reservations required?
questions.answer: Reservations are generally required for specialty restaurants such as Polo Grill, Toscana, Jacques, Red Ginger, and Tuscan Steak. The Grand Dining Room, Terrace Café, Waves Grill, and Aquamar Kitchen do not require reservations.

questions.question: Can you make dining reservations before boarding?
questions.answer: Yes. Specialty restaurant reservations open online prior to departure based on accommodation tier. Suites receive the earliest booking window, followed by Concierge Level Veranda staterooms and standard Verandas.

questions.question: Can you eat at specialty restaurants more than once?
questions.answer: Yes, depending on sailing length and reservation availability. Guests can secure one reservation in each included specialty restaurant in advance, and request additional bookings with the onboard maître d' upon embarkation.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises offer open seating?
questions.answer: Yes. The Grand Dining Room generally uses open seating, allowing guests to dine anytime during operating hours without a traditional fixed early or late dinner assignment. Specialty restaurants require specific reservation times.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises offer room service?
questions.answer: Yes. Complimentary 24-hour in-room dining is available for all guests. Concierge Level and suite guests enjoy expanded room-service selections ordered directly from The Grand Dining Room, with full course-by-course butler service in Penthouse Suites and above.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises offer vegetarian meals?
questions.answer: Yes. Vegetarian and plant-forward selections are available across all dining venues. The Grand Dining Room features dedicated vegetarian menus, and Aquamar Kitchen specializes in wellness-focused plant-forward cuisine.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises offer vegan meals?
questions.answer: Yes. Plant-based dishes are available fleet-wide. Guests following a strict vegan diet should communicate their requirements prior to sailing and verify individual recipes with the onboard culinary team.

questions.question: Can Oceania accommodate gluten-free diets?
questions.answer: Yes. Guests can communicate gluten-free dietary requirements to Oceania before departure. The culinary staff prepares gluten-free bread, pasta, and custom entrées with strict cross-contact precautions.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises accommodate food allergies?
questions.answer: Yes. Guests should disclose food allergies in advance and consult with the dining staff upon embarkation. The Executive Chef and restaurant managers review ingredients and preparation methods for each meal.

questions.question: Is alcohol included with dining on Oceania Cruises?
questions.answer: Oceania's Your World Included program includes selected wine and beer by the glass during restaurant lunch and dinner hours when that option is selected. Premium spirits, reserve cellar wines, and drinks outside dining hours may carry extra charges.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises have a buffet?
questions.answer: Yes. Terrace Café is the main casual buffet-style restaurant, offering made-to-order breakfast, extensive international lunch selections, and evening grilled seafood and steaks with indoor and alfresco terrace seating.

questions.question: Does Oceania Cruises have a poolside restaurant?
questions.answer: Yes. Waves Grill provides casual poolside dining, featuring gourmet Kobe burgers, grilled seafood, fresh salads, milkshakes, and artisanal gelato by the scoop.
